name: Power Power Supply — BatteryClip
description: Through-hole battery clip components supporting Keystone 54 D16-19mm footprints for power supply applications.
selection_hints: Match PCB land pattern to the Keystone 54 D16-19mm battery clip footprint.
Verify physical cell diameter compatibility (16mm to 19mm) and through-hole layout.
Review legacy catalog data and tier C quality rating prior to design integration.
avoid_when: Surface-mount (SMD) battery holders or clips are required.
The design requires battery cell sizes outside the 16-19mm range or a different footprint geometry.
A package family other than BatteryClip is required.
